authority: Each code denotes one defined capability; labels and icons are presentation only. Claim mode and verified credentials must be considered before a capability qualifies a candidate for a shift. Unknown codes never match.

levels.experience: May claim experience within lawful scope

certificates.label: First aid, CPR and anaphylaxis certificate
Aged Care On-site Pharmacist training and program credentials
Travel health / Yellow Fever training and authorisation

skills.label: Prescription dispensing
skills.note: Assistants require verified dispensary competencies. All non-pharmacist dispensing work is under direct pharmacist supervision and does not include the final clinical check.
skills.definition: Pick, label and supply scripts; the pharmacist does the final check.

skills.label: Script entry and labelling
skills.note: Assistant conditional on dispensary training and pharmacist supervision.
skills.definition: Enter scripts into the dispensing system and print labels, flagging concerns to the pharmacist.

skills.label: Clinical script checking
skills.note: Interns check under pharmacist supervision; the registered pharmacist keeps final responsibility.
skills.definition: Final clinical and legal check of each prescription before it is supplied.

skills.label: eScripts and tokens
skills.definition: Dispense electronic prescriptions from QR tokens and Active Script Lists.

skills.label: PBS claims
skills.definition: Prepare and reconcile PBS claims and safety net records.

skills.label: Medication counselling
skills.note: Intern and student only under pharmacist supervision.
skills.definition: Explain to patients how to take their medicines safely.

skills.label: OTC and pharmacy medicine advice (S2/S3)
skills.note: Assistants need S2/S3 training and refer pharmacist-only (S3) requests.
skills.definition: Recommend OTC and S2 medicines, and refer S3 requests to the pharmacist.

skills.label: S8 and controlled drugs
skills.note: Legal permissions and pharmacist oversight still apply.
skills.definition: Handle S8 safe access, register entries and balance checks.

skills.label: Webster / DAA packing
skills.definition: Pack dose administration aids such as Webster-paks.

skills.label: Webster / DAA checking
skills.note: Interns check under pharmacist supervision; the registered pharmacist keeps final responsibility.
skills.icon_meaning: Blister pack with a check mark
skills.definition: Pharmacist final check of packed DAAs before release.

skills.label: ODT dosing (methadone, buprenorphine)
skills.note: Technical support is not independent dosing.
skills.definition: Supervised opioid dependence treatment dosing, records and balances.

skills.label: Staged supply
skills.note: Clinical supply decisions remain pharmacist-only.
skills.definition: Prepare daily or weekly staged pick-ups.

skills.label: Compounding
skills.note: Non-sterile compounding is within normal pharmacy practice; no separate certificate is requested.
skills.definition: Prepare non-sterile products from a formula.

skills.label: Sterile / advanced compounding
skills.note: Specialist training and additional safeguards apply.
skills.definition: Aseptic or complex compounding in a specialist facility.

skills.label: Medication reconciliation
skills.note: Hospital technicians take medication histories under credentialing; pharmacists reconcile.
skills.definition: Compare medicine lists at admission, discharge or review.

skills.label: Medicinal cannabis
skills.note: Clinical decisions remain pharmacist-only.
skills.definition: Dispense medicinal cannabis and counsel patients on its use.

skills.label: Dispensing robot (Rowa / Alpaca)
skills.definition: Load, run and troubleshoot a dispensing robot.

skills.label: Medicine deliveries
skills.note: Follow privacy and medicine handling policies.
skills.definition: Deliver medicines to homes or aged care and confirm the handover.

skills.label: Vaccinations
skills.note: Intern conditional on jurisdictional authorisation, training and supervision.
skills.definition: Give vaccines as an accredited immuniser and report to the AIR.

skills.label: First Aid / CPR
skills.definition: Provide first aid and cardiopulmonary resuscitation in accordance with current training and workplace emergency protocols.

skills.label: MedsCheck / Diabetes MedsCheck
skills.note: Supervised trainee involvement only.
skills.definition: Run MedsCheck and Diabetes MedsCheck consultations.

skills.label: HMR / RMMR reviews
skills.note: Credentialed pharmacist only.
skills.definition: Accredited Home and Residential Medication Management Reviews.

skills.label: Aged care on-site pharmacist (ACOP)
skills.note: Accredited training and program rules apply.
skills.definition: Work on-site in residential aged care under the ACOP program.

skills.label: Hospital pharmacy
skills.definition: Ward, clinical or dispensary work in a public or private hospital.

skills.label: Aged care pharmacy supply
skills.definition: Supply aged care homes: medication charts, DAAs, imprest stock and visits.

skills.label: Health checks (BP, glucose, cholesterol)
skills.note: Assistants measure under pharmacy procedures; the pharmacist interprets and refers.
skills.definition: Measure blood pressure and screen glucose or cholesterol, referring when needed.

skills.label: NDSS access point
skills.note: Diabetes advice stays with the pharmacist.
skills.definition: Register NDSS members and supply subsidised diabetes products.

skills.label: Wound care
skills.definition: Assess minor wounds, choose dressings and refer when needed.

skills.label: Cold chain and vaccine fridge
skills.definition: Monitor vaccine fridge temperatures and manage breaches.

skills.label: UTI prescribing
skills.note: Jurisdiction-specific authorisation.
skills.definition: Treat uncomplicated UTIs under a state pharmacist prescribing program.

skills.label: Contraceptive pill resupply
skills.note: Jurisdiction-specific authorisation.
skills.definition: Resupply oral contraceptives under a state pharmacist program.

skills.label: Skin condition prescribing
skills.note: Subject to local authorised scope.
skills.definition: Treat minor skin conditions such as dermatitis under state programs.

skills.label: Travel health / yellow fever
skills.note: Clinic and state authorisations may apply.
skills.definition: Travel vaccines and yellow fever services where authorised.

skills.label: Customer service and POS
skills.definition: Serve customers, run the register and hand out click-and-collect orders.

skills.label: Vitamins and supplements
skills.definition: Advise on vitamins and complementary medicines.

skills.label: Skincare and beauty
skills.definition: Advise on skincare, cosmetics and fragrance.

skills.label: Merchandising and planograms
skills.definition: Set shelves to planogram, price stock and build promotions.

skills.label: Stock ordering
skills.definition: Order from wholesalers such as API, Sigma and Symbion, and chase backorders.

skills.label: Stock control
skills.definition: Receive deliveries, rotate expiry dates, process returns and do stocktakes.

skills.label: Service and vaccination bookings
skills.definition: Book and manage vaccination and pharmacy service appointments.

skills.label: Pharmacy administration
skills.definition: Rosters, invoices, filing and other back-office work.

skills.label: Front-of-shop management
skills.definition: Run the retail floor: team, sales, displays and targets.

skills.label: Staff training and supervision
skills.definition: Train and supervise pharmacy staff.

skills.label: Sole pharmacist / pharmacist in charge
skills.note: Appropriate general registration and appointment required.
skills.definition: Run the pharmacy as the only pharmacist on shift.

icon_standard.web: lucide-react outline glyphs drawn in brand navy over a group accent shape (frontend_web/shared/SkillGlyph.tsx)
icon_standard.mobile: MaterialCommunityIcons via @expo/vector-icons over the same accent shape (frontend_mobile/components/SkillIcon.tsx)
icon_standard.style: Duotone spot symbols: navy linework, one flat accent shape tinted from the group's brand colour (violet dispensing, cyan clinical, magenta retail, blue software); two motion arcs only at onboarding size and on selection.
icon_standard.special: Custom blister pack (seven days x four doses, 4 x 3 at badge size), blister check, robotic arm and mortar-and-pestle glyphs drawn on Lucide's grid and stroke; the check mark names the task, not a verified status.

matching_rules.normalisation: Canonical code, case-insensitive label or explicit alias only; never fuzzy-match free text for eligibility.
matching_rules.scope: Only legal role-compatible claims; supervision and credential verification must be checked separately.
matching_rules.explorer: Explorer interests are not professional skills; do not match them to skilled pharmacy shifts.
matching_rules.unknown: Legacy unknown claims can be shown for audit but never counted as a match.
matching_rules.certificate: A self-selected skill or uploaded file is not automatically a verified qualification.

software_logos.policy: Each vendor's own compact mark (app icon, favicon or the mark inside its official logo), unaltered apart from cropping to the mark and resizing, shown beside the product name to say a worker has used that software; no endorsement implied. Products without a confirmed official mark use the ChemistTasker software symbol.

pharmacy_profile.benchmark_note: Cut-offs follow the Victorian Pharmacy Authority benchmark (about 150 prescriptions per full-time pharmacist on a typical day, pro rata at weekends) and the Pharmacy Board guide reported by the Guild (extra pharmacist or dispensary technician above 200 items a day).

shift_posting.note: Short lists shown first on Post shift, from Australian locum, SEEK and Employment Hero ads and dispensary/assistant job descriptions; the full catalogue stays one tap away.

levels.label: Level 1
levels.explainer: No completed Community Pharmacy qualification. This level does not establish dispensary competence.

levels.label: Level 2
levels.explainer: SIR20116 — Certificate II in Community Pharmacy. Dispensing competence must be evidenced separately.

levels.label: Level 3
levels.explainer: SIR30116 — Certificate III in Community Pharmacy. For dispensary work, evidence must include the dispensary stream / SIRCDIS003 Assist in dispensing prescriptions.

levels.label: Level 4
levels.explainer: SIR40116 — Certificate IV in Community Pharmacy, or SIR40216 — Certificate IV in Community Pharmacy Dispensary. General pharmacy training alone does not establish dispensing competence.

dispensary.label: Level 3 — dispensary stream
dispensary.explainer: SIR30116 — Certificate III in Community Pharmacy, including SIRCDIS003 Assist in dispensing prescriptions. Upload the qualification and unit transcript together.

dispensary.label: Level 4 — dispensary qualification
dispensary.explainer: SIR40216 — Certificate IV in Community Pharmacy Dispensary, or SIR40116 — Certificate IV in Community Pharmacy including SIRCDIS003. Upload the qualification and unit transcript together.

dispensary.label: Community Pharmacy Dispensary skill set
dispensary.explainer: SIRSS00012 — Community Pharmacy Dispensary. Includes SIRCDIS003 Assist in dispensing prescriptions.

dispensary.label: Dispensing unit / recognised equivalent
dispensary.explainer: SIRCDIS003 — Assist in dispensing prescriptions, or documented equivalent competencies/RPL assessed by the administrator. This is not an award level.
